svg.title: Ashwagandha in food supplements
svg.desc: Status by country, as of 19 October 2026. Banned in food supplements: Denmark. Products removed, or a ban is planned: Sweden (case by case), Netherlands (draft leaf ban). Sold; authority advises some groups to avoid it: France, Germany. Sold; no specific national restriction found: Spain.
